Yoman.g: “yo bhikkhu imaṁ rāgapalipathañceva kilesaduggañca saṁsāravaṭṭañca catunnaṁ saccānaṁ appaṭivijjhanakamohañca atīto cattāro oghe tiṇṇo hutvā pāraṁ anuppatto, duvidhena jhānena jhāyī, taṇhāya abhāvena anejo, kathaṁkathāya abhāvena akathaṁkathī, upādānānaṁ abhāvena anupādiyitvā kilesanibbānena nibbuto, tamahaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ vadāmī”ti attho.

Yomaṁ.g: “yo bhikkhu imaṁ rāgapalipathañceva kilesaduggañca saṁsāravaṭṭañca catunnaṁ saccānaṁ appaṭivijjhanakamohañca atīto cattāro oghe tiṇṇo hutvā pāraṁ anuppatto, duvidhena jhānena jhāyī, taṇhāya abhāvena anejo, kathaṁkathāya abhāvena akathaṁkathī, upādānānaṁ abhāvena anupādiyitvā kilesanibbānena nibbuto, tamahaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ vadāmī”ti attho.
